CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.
   D. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.

   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

   C. Use Monarchy in Israel: King David to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King David with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
